home.question.carefully: Sicela ufunde imibuzo ngokucophelela futhi uphendule ngokwethembeka
home.heading: Siyakwamukela ku-Zamplia!
home.introText: Sijabule kakhulu ukuthi ulapha njengengxenye yomphakathi wethu! Ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlolovo zethu, uvula ithuba lokuzuza imivuzo ethokozisayo futhi wenze izwi lakho lizwakale. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola ulwazi olungcono kakhulu nemivuzo, nawa amathiphu ambalwa alula:
home.tip1.heading: Thembeka futhi ube Nomcabango
home.tip1.text: Izimpendulo zakho ezithembekile zisiza thina ukunikeza amathuba angcono futhi zandise amathuba akho okuzuza imivuzo ephezulu!
home.tip2.heading: Zinike Isikhathi
home.tip2.text: Ukuphuthuma ezinhlolovo kungakwenza ungakwazi ukuthola imivuzo, ngakho-ke zinike isikhathi futhi wenze impendulo ngayinye ibe nokubaluleka!
home.tip3.heading: Gcina Kubuqotho
home.tip3.text: Sisebenzisa amasistimu athuthukile ukuze sithole umsebenzi osolisayo, futhi izinhlolovo ezinezimpendulo ezingahambelani noma ezizenzakalelayo zizosuswa.
home.tip4.heading: Yandisa Imivuzo Yakho
home.tip4.text: Landela lawa mathiphu ukuze unikeze imininingwane ebalulekile futhi uhlale ufanelekile ukuthola imivuzo engcono kakhulu endaweni yethu!
home.footermessage: Sicela ugweme ukuvuselela noma ukushiya ikhasi kuze kuqedwe inhlolovo. Hlala ugxilile futhi uphendule ngokucophelela ukuze uvimbele ukunqanyulwa okungadingekile!

cookies.intro: Le Nqubomgomo Yamakhukhi ichaza ukuthi Zamplia Ltd. (“Zamplia” noma “thina”, “yethu” noma “thina”) isebenzisa kanjani Amakhukhi nobuchwepheshe obufanayo. Ukuze uthole imininingwane eyengeziwe, sicela ubone Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo yethu.
cookies.cookiesDescription: Amakhukhi ayizicucu ezincane zedatha ezilondolozwa kukhompuyutha yakho, ifoni yakho ephathekayo, noma enye idivayisi uma uvakashela ikhasi okokuqala ngqa. Sisebenzisa amakhukhi, ama-web beacons, izinto ezabiwe endaweni (ngezinye izikhathi ezibizwa ngokuthi “amakhukhi esikhathi esifushane”), izihlonzi zeselula, nobuchwepheshe obufanayo (“Amakhukhi”) ukuze sikusize sikubone ku-Zamplia, sithuthukise ulwazi lwakho lomsebenzisi, futhi siqonde ukusetshenziswa kwe-Zamplia.
cookies.typesIntro: Singasetha Amakhukhi uma uvakashela i-Zamplia. Angasethwa futhi ngamanye amawebhusayithi noma izinsizakalo eziqhuba okuqukethwe ekhasini olivakashelayo. Ngemuva kokuthi ubhalise kumasayithi ethu, kufaka phakathi i-www.zamplia.com, singaxhuma imininingwane elondolozwe Kumakhukhi neminye imininingwane etholwe kuwe.
cookies.typesNote: Ukunikezwa kwedatha yakho ngamakhukhi kungokuzithandela. Ukusetshenziswa kwamakhukhi kungabandakanya ukuqoqwa, ukucubungula, kanye/noma ukusetshenziswa kwedatha yomuntu siqu emazweni angaphandle kwe-European Economic Area, angahlinzeki ngezinga elifanayo lokuvikela idatha njengasezweni lakini. Ungakwazi ukuhoxisa imvume yakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngokususa Amakhukhi.
cookies.sessionCookies: Amakhukhi E-Session – Amakhukhi esikhashana asuswayo uma ushiya i-Zamplia.
cookies.persistentCookies: Amakhukhi Angapheli – Ahlala kudivayisi yakho kuze kube yilapho esuswa ngesandla.
cookies.usageIntro: Amakhukhi angadlulisela imininingwane ngawe nokusebenzisa kwakho i-Zamplia, njengohlobo lwebrawuza yakho kanye nemininingwane yedivayisi. Amakhukhi angaxhumana nemininingwane ethile eyingqayizivele, njengezihloko zomsebenzi owazifaka ngesikhathi sokubhalisa noma kuphrofayela yakho, kodwa lokhu akuxhunyaniswanga negama lakho.
cookies.auth: Ukuqinisekiswa – Ukusiza thina ukuqinisekisa wena ukuze silethe okuqukethwe okwenziwe kwaba okwakho.
cookies.performance: Ukusebenza – Ukwenza i-Zamplia kube lula futhi kusheshe ukuyisebenzisa.
cookies.features: Izici – Ukunika amandla izici nokugcina imininingwane ngawe nokusebenzisa kwakho i-Zamplia.
cookies.adChoicesText: Ungakwazi ukuvala amanye (kodwa hhayi wonke) Amakhukhi ngokulungisa izilungiselelo zebrawuza yakho, yize lokhu kungase kubiwe ulwazi lwakho lomsebenzisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ungaphatha futhi ususe amakhukhi ngezilungiselelo zebrawuza yakho. Umthombo olusizo wolwazi ngokususa nokulawula amakhukhi ungatholakala ku-<aboutCookies>AboutCookies.org</aboutCookies>. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi uma izikhangiso noma ezinye izici ku-Zamplia zinikezwa abantu besithathu, bangasetha futhi basebenzise Amakhukhi abo ngokungena ngezinhlelo zabo zobumfihlo. I-Zamplia ayinakho ukufinyelela noma ukulawula kulawa makhukhi.
cookies.policyText: Ungasusa amakhukhi kudivayisi yakho kanye/noma ushintshe izilungiselelo zebrawuza noma zedivayisi yakho. Ezinye izingxenye zesayithi lethu zingase zingasebenzi kahle uma uvala amakhukhi.
cookies.avoidCookiesTitle: Yini enye engingayenza ukuze ngigweme amakhukhi?
cookies.avoidCookiesText: Ngokuvamile, noma yimuphi ulwazi lomuntu siqu oluqoqwe ngesikhathi senhlolokhulumo aludalulwa kubantu besithathu. Kodwa-ke, kwezinye izimo, iklayenti elixhasa iphrojekthi yocwaningo lingafuna ukuxhumana nabaphenduli ngqo. Kwezinjalo izimo, i-Zamplia ichaza isizathu sokudalula futhi ithole imvume esobala ngaphambi kokwenza noma yikuphi ukudalula okunjalo.
cookies.emailCookiesText: Ama-imeyili ethu aqukethe amakhukhi abheka ukuthi uwavula yini futhi uchofoza yini kunoma yiziphi izixhumanisi. Lawa makhukhi ayingqayizivele ku-imeyili ngayinye futhi awalondolozwe kukhompuyutha yakho noma idivayisi ephathekayo.
cookies.securityText: Ipulatifomu yethu isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokufaka iminwe yedivayisi nokulandela ukuziphatha kuphela ngenjongo yezokuphepha nokuvikela ukukhwabanisa. Lawa mathuluzi asisiza ukuqinisekisa abasebenzisi bangempela futhi avimbele umsebenzi ozenzakalelayo noma onobungozi. Ayikho imininingwane yomuntu siqu eqoqwayo ngaphandle uma uyinikeza ngokucacile (njengokwezimpendulo zocwaningo).
cookies.securityPoint1: Asisebenzisi amakhukhi okukhangisa noma okulandela okuphambanayo-nesayithi.
cookies.securityPoint2: Idatha yokufaka iminwe yedivayisi icubungulwa kuphela ngemuva kokuthi wamukele izinqubomgomo zethu futhi isuswa ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingama-30.
cookies.securityPoint3: Ungakwazi ukukhetha ukuphuma ngokushiya ipulatifomu ngaphambi kokwamukela.
cookies.questionsText: Uma unemibuzo ngemuva kokufunda le Nqubomgomo Yamakhukhi, sicela uxhumane no <emailLink>privacy@zamplia.com</emailLink>.

privacy.intro1: I-Zamplia Ltd. (“Zamplia”) iyinkampani yocwaningo lwemakethe, egxile ekuqoqweni kwedatha. Kwa-Zamplia, ukuhlonipha ubumfihlo kuyisibopho esibalulekile esinabo kubahlanganyeli kanye nomphakathi jikelele.
privacy.intro2: Uma ubamba iqhaza ocwaningweni olwenziwa yinkampani yethu, kungaba ubuso nobuso, ngocingo, ngeposi noma ku-inthanethi, ungaba nesiqiniseko sokuthi izimpendulo zakho zizogcinwa ziyimfihlo. Ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu ngeke luthengiswe noma ludayiselwe muntu. Ukubamba iqhaza kuphelele kuwe — ungakhetha ukungaphenduli imibuzo ethile noma uyeke noma yinini.
privacy.intro3: Inqubomgomo yobumfihlo yeZamplia iyisitatimende semigomo nemiyalelo echaza izinga lokuvikelwa kolwazi lomuntu oluhlinzekwa kubahlanganyeli nakumphakathi. Inhloso yale nqubomgomo ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko aphendulayo, acacile futhi ahambisana nemithetho efana ne-Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (Canada), i-General Data Protection Regulation (EU), kanye ne-California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Siyingxenye ye-Canadian Research and Insights Council (CRIC), i-American Association for Public Opinion Research (AAPOR), kanye ne-Insights Association, okuyizinhlangano ezibeka amazinga avikelayo kubahlanganyeli.
privacy.collectionIntro: I-Zamplia iqoqela ulwazi lomuntu kuphela ngezizathu ezichaziwe. Izizathu zokulusebenzisa zivezwa ngesikhathi noma ngaphambi kokuqoqwa kolwazi.
privacy.collectionPoint1: Ngesikhathi socwaningo lwemakethe nolwezomphakathi (ubuso nobuso, ngocingo, noma ku-inthanethi), singaqoqa imininingwane yakho eyisisekelo (igama, ikheli, inombolo yocingo, ikheli le-imeyili). Sizohambisana nemithetho nezimfuneko zomthetho lapho kudingeka imvume yakho.
privacy.collectionPoint2: Njengomqoqi wedatha (Data Processor), singathola imininingwane evela kumakhasimende ethu ukuze sikumeme ocwaningweni. Lokhu kungafaka igama eligcwele, isikhundla, igama lenkampani, ikheli le-imeyili, inombolo yocingo, ikheli leposi, noma olunye ulwazi olukhomba umuntu.
privacy.collectionPoint3: Uma ukhetha ukubhalisela izingxoxo zethu noma ucwaningo lwe-inthanethi, singaqoqa imininingwane yokubhalisa efana negama, ikheli leposi, nekheli le-imeyili.
privacy.collectionPoint4: Uma ubamba iqhaza ocwaningweni lwe-inthanethi noma uvakashela iwebhusayithi yethu, singaqoqa imininingwane ngokuzenzakalelayo (ikheli le-IP, indawo, isiphequluli) sisebenzisa ama-cookies noma ama-log files.
privacy.useIntro: I-Zamplia izochaza ngokusobala izizathu zokusetshenziswa kolwazi lomuntu ngesikhathi noma ngaphambi kokuqoqwa. Uma kuvela izizathu ezintsha ezingachaziwe ekuqaleni, imvume yakho izocelwa ngaphambi kokuba ulwazi lusetshenziswe ngalezo zizathu ezintsha. Singabelana ngedatha ngokuhlanganisiwe kuphela (okungakhombisi muntu ngamunye).
privacy.useSubtitle: Sisebenzisa ulwazi lomuntu kuphela ngezizathu ezilandelayo:
privacy.usePoint5: Ukuphendula imibuzo noma izicelo ezithunyelwe nge-imeyili noma ngocingo.
privacy.usePoint7: Ukuphenya ubugebengu obungaba khona noma ukwephula amalungelo kuwebhusayithi.
privacy.usePoint8: Ukuphendula izicelo zakho ezihlobene nezinsizakalo noma ucwaningo.
privacy.consentText:
Ukuqoqwa, ukusetshenziswa noma ukwabelana ngolwazi lomuntu kudinga imvume ecacile. Ukubamba iqhaza ocwaningweni kuhlala kuwukuzikhethela. Izizathu zivezwa ngendlela ecacile ukuze kuqondwe. Imvume kufanele inikezwe ngokucacile, mahhala, nangolwazi oluphelele.
Ngokuvamile, ulwazi oluqoqwa ngesikhathi socwaningo alukabelwana nabanye. Kodwa kwezinye izimo amakhasimende ocwaningo angafuna ukuxhumana nawe ngqo. Kulokhu, sizocela imvume yakho ecacile ngaphambi kokwabelana ngemininingwane yakho.
privacy.sensitiveText:
Ngaphakathi kocwaningo, singacubungula ulwazi olubucayi (ukuzalwa, imicabango yezombusazwe, inkolo, amalungu enhlangano, imininingwane yezofuzo, idatha yokukhomba umuntu, impilo noma ubulili). Lolu lwazi luzocutshungulwa kuphela uma kuvunyelwe ngumthetho.
Asiqoqi ulwazi lwabantwana ngaphandle kwemvume yabazali futhi sizohambisana nemithetho yendawo. Uma kwenzeka luqoqwa ngaphandle kwemvume, sizolususwa ngokushesha.
privacy.sharingIntro: I-Zamplia ayisoze yanikeza ulwazi lwakho kwabanye ukuze balusebenzise ngezizathu zokuthengisa. Singabelana ngolwazi kuphela ngezizathu ezichazwe ngezansi futhi siqinisekise ukuthi luvikelwe.
privacy.sharingPoint1: Singadlulisela ulwazi phakathi kwezinkampani ezihlobene neZamplia eCanada nase-USA. Kodwa asisoze sanikezela ulwazi lwabahlanganyeli ngaphandle kwemvume ecacile.
privacy.sharingPoint2: Singawabelana nabaqoqi bedatha abasisizayo (isb: izinkampani zokuthumela ama-imeyili, izikhungo zokugcina idatha). Sibophezela laba bahlinzeki ekulandeleni imithetho yokuvikelwa kwedatha.
privacy.sharingPoint3: Singawabelana namakhasimende akhiphe ucwaningo ukuze siwenzelwe wona, ngokuhambisana nemithetho efanele.
privacy.sharingPoint4: Singabelana nodaba uma kudingwa ngumthetho noma uma kudingeka ukuvikela impilo noma impahla.
privacy.securityText: I-Zamplia ivikela ulwazi lomuntu kusukela ekulahlekelweni, ekwebiweni, noma ekusetshenzisweni okungagunyaziwe ngezindlela zobuchwepheshe, ezenhlangano nezokuphatha. Singahambisana namazinga amazwe okuvikelwa kolwazi. Kuphela abasebenzi abagunyaziwe abanezidingo zomsebenzi abavunyelwe ukufinyelela ulwazi lwakho.
privacy.deviceText: Sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuthola imininingwane kudivayisi kanye nokuhlaziya ukuziphatha ukuze sivikele ipulatifomu yethu ekukhwabaniseni nasekusetshenzisweni kabi. Uma usebenzisa izinsizakalo zethu futhi uvumelana nemigomo yethu, singaqoqa imininingwane yobuchwepheshe edivayisini yakho (uhlobo lwedivayisi, isiphequluli, imininingwane ye-hardware, inethiwekhi, nokuziphatha okufana nokunyakaza kwegundane noma indlela yokuthayipha). Lokhu kusisiza:
privacy.devicePoint3: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzisi ngamunye uqondene nowakhe kuphela.
privacy.dataUsePoint1: Isetshenziswa kuphela ezinjongo zokuphepha nokuvimbela ubugebengu.
privacy.dataUsePoint2: Asiyisebenzisi ezikhangisweni noma ekwakheni amaphrofayela angaphezulu, futhi asabelani ngayo nabanye.
privacy.dataUsePoint3: Idatha igcinwa ngokuphepha izinsuku ezingafika ku-30 bese isuswa unomphela.
privacy.rightPoint1: Unelungelo lokufinyelela, ukulungisa noma ukususa ulwazi lwakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngokusithinta.
privacy.rightPoint2: Uma ungafuni ukuqoqwa kwalolu lwazi, ungakhetha ukuhoxisa futhi uphume kupulatifomu yethu.

terms.generalIntro: Lena imibandela ejwayelekile esebenzayo ekusebenziseni izinsizakalo zethu.
terms.contractNotice: LE MIBANDELA EJWAYELEKILE ilawula ukusetshenziswa kwakho kwe <site>www.zamplia.com</site> kanye namanye amasayithi ewebhu nawemobile lapho sixhumanisa khona nale mibandela (kanye - 'Amasayithi'). Ngokuvakashela, ukufinyelela, noma ukusebenzisa noma yiliphi iSayithi, uyavuma (noma uqinisekisa) isivumelwano esibophezela ngokomthetho ne Zamplia Ltd., ene-ofisi enkulu eToronto, Canada, ngokusekelwe kule mibandela ejwayelekile. Uma ungavumelani nanoma yiziphi izimo, kufanele uyeke ukusebenzisa wonke amasayithi ngokushesha.
terms.conditionalTitle: Ilayisensi Ezingaphansi Kwezimo Yokusebenzisa Amasayithi Wethu
terms.conditionalText: Sikunikeza ilayisensi elinganiselwe, elingaphendulwa, elingadluliseki futhi elingeyona eliyingqayizivele lokusebenzisa Amasayithi ethu, uma kuphela ukuthi uyavuma futhi ulandela le mibandela ejwayelekile futhi usebenzisa Amasayithi kuphela ekubambeni kuzo izivivinyo zemakethe. Awunalo ilungelo lokuthengisa kabusha noma ukusabalalisa ulwazi noma izinsizakalo ezitholakala kuAmasayithi. Uma usebenzisa Amasayithi ngokuphula le mibandela noma umthetho, uyaphula isivumelwano sethu kanye namalungelo ethu empahla yobuhlakani.
terms.restrictionsText: Kufanele ulandele yonke imithetho yethu ethi 'UNGAKWENZI' kanye 'NEKUFANELE', futhi ungasebenzisi Amasayithi ngokuphula umthetho noma amalungelo abantu besithathu. Sigcina ilungelo lokuzikhethela nangokwezimiso zomthetho ukuqeda imilayezo, okuqukethwe, umlando wezokuxhumana namakhawunti abasebenzisi uma kutholakala ukwephula le mibandela.
terms.contactIntro: Uma unemibuzo, iziphakamiso noma izikhalazo, sicela uxhumane nathi:
terms.changesText: Singaguqula Amasayithi noma le mibandela ejwayelekile, noma siyeke ukusebenza kunoma yiliphi iSayithi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kwesaziso sangaphambili. Singadlulisela futhi isivumelwano sethu enhlanganweni ehlobene noma kumthengi wempahla. Uma ungafuni ukwamukela lezi zinguquko, indlela yakho eyodwa wukuyeka ukusebenzisa Amasayithi.
terms.paymentsText: Uyaqonda ukuthi iZamplia isebenza njengesikhulumi esixhumanisa ababambiqhaza bezivivinyo namathuba okuziphendulela. I-Zamplia ayikukhokheli ngqo; noma yiziphi izincomo ozitholayo zivela enkampanini yakho yephaneli noma kuwebhusayithi yomlingani.
terms.warrantyText: Sinikeza Amasayithi 'njengoba ekhona' ngaphandle kwesibopho esicacile noma esingaqondile. Usebenzisa Amasayithi engozini yakho siqu. Asiqinisekisi ukuthi Amasayithi azosebenza ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, ngesikhathi, ngokuphepha noma ngaphandle kwamaphutha.
terms.limitationText: Ngokwesilinganiso esiphezulu esivunyelwe ngumthetho, siyala futhi sikhipha noma yimuphi umthwalo weZamplia Ltd. kanye nabaqondisi bayo, abasebenzi, izinsiza kanye nabaqashi kunoma yiziphi izimfanelo eziqondile, ezingaqondile, ezingalindelekile noma ezingalindelekile, ngaphandle kwamacala okwephula ngenhloso noma ukunganaki okukhulu.
terms.indemnityText: Uqinisekisa ukuthi noma yiluphi okuqukethwe nolwazi olufakwa noma ludluliswa ngeAmasayithi luyasebenza, luyiqiniso futhi luyingeyakho noma lunelayisense kuwe. Uthwala umthwalo ophelele walokho okuqukethwe futhi uyavuma ukusivikela nokubuyisela noma yiziphi izindleko, izimangalo noma izindleko (kufaka phakathi nezindleko zommeli).
terms.indemnityPoint2: Noma yiluphi ukuphula le mibandela ejwayelekile noma umthetho.
terms.indemnityPoint3: Ukuphulwa kwamalungelo abantu besithathu ezenzweni zakho (amalungelo obunikazi, impahla, ubumfihlo, njll).
terms.indemnityPoint4: Noma yisiphi isimangalo sokuthi okuqukethwe kwakho kubangele ukulimala komuntu wesithathu.
terms.choiceOfLaw: Lo msebenzi wokuvikela nokubuyisela izindleko usebenza ngisho noma imibandela ishintsha noma ukusetshenziswa kweAmasayithi kuyeka. Umthetho ofanele kanye nokulamula kuyasebenza.
terms.securityMeasuresText: Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenzisa ipulatifomu yethu, uyavuma futhi uyavuma ukuthi ngemva kokwamukela inqubomgomo yethu, singaqoqa futhi sicubungule idatha mayelana namadivayisi akho nokuziphatha ngenhloso yokuphepha, ukuthola ubugebengu nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuhlukahluka kwezivivinyo. Yonke idatha icutshungulwa ngokuya Ngenqubomgomo yethu Yobumfihlo futhi ayithengiswa noma idluliselwe ngaphandle kwenhlangano.
terms.do1: Landela Imibandela Ejwayelekile yethu kanye nawo wonke umthetho nemithetho.
terms.do2: Vikela ID yomsebenzisi wakho kanye nephasiwedi futhi uyigcine imfihlo.
terms.dont2: Ungasebenzisi Amasayithi uma ungumcitshwayo we-EU ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-16.
terms.dont3: Ungagqashuki izinyathelo zobuchwepheshe zokuvikela ukufinyelela ulwazi kuAmasayithi.
terms.dont4: Ungasebenzisi ama-robot, izipho, ama-scraper noma amanye amathuluzi ezenzakalelayo (ngaphandle kwama-browser ajwayelekile).
terms.dont6Point1: Izinto zokulondoloza amalungelo obunikazi, izimfihlo zebhizinisi noma impahla yobuhlakani bomuntu wesithathu ngaphandle kwemvume.
terms.dont6Point2: Ulwazi olungamanga noma olukhwabanisayo olungalimaza abanye.
terms.dont6Point3: Okuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni, okucasulayo, okusongelayo, okuphikisanayo noma okunezinhlanga ezihlukanisayo.
terms.dont6Point4: I-virus, i-worm, izinhlelo ze-Trojan noma amakhodi amabi.
terms.dont7: Ungasebenzisi i-akhawunti yomunye umuntu noma uziphenduke ngomunye.
terms.dont9: Ungazami ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe ezinhlelweni noma ama-akhawunti ethu.
terms.dont11: Ungakopishi noma wabelane nganoma iyiphi ingxenye yeSayithi ngaphandle kwemvume.
